Base fence block-destructive-bash.sh:1464-1475 trusts such rows to unlock a spike-branch force-delete.
critique: disable-model-invocation hides the slash command from the Skill tool only; the Bash tool reaches the script directly and the prose-scanning bats tests are not a runtime control.
remediation: One-shot nonce minted by the /decisions session and consumed by the operator ops, or a PreToolUse Bash deny on dec-write-lib.sh confirm|context --clear; make context --clear session-bound; reword decisions.md:24-28.

finding: An operator confirm under a PRD **Status:** autonomous|unattended signal discards the operator's cli: ref and records decided_by: agent while the row still becomes decided.
reasoning_trace: op_confirm refuses only on live_run_signal (:509) but derive_attribution short-circuits on is_unattended (:313), which includes the prd signal (:177-180); :538 then sets decided_by to proposed_by. Reproduced with repro-attr.sh: rc=0, WARN printed, list shows agent | decided.
critique: The same predicate kills operator reject of decided rows (:575) and downgrades operator supersede (:600, :606).
remediation: Skip the unattended short-circuit when is_operator_call && ! live_run_signal; assert decided_by in tests/unit/dec-write-lib.bats:362-365.

finding: op_reject rewrites only the rejected row; the superseded row's supersede_proposed_by keeps pointing at the rejected id, the guard at :600-602 refuses every later agent supersede, the validator (:653-654) accepts the state and the append-only rule (:681-682) forbids nulling the field.
reasoning_trace: Reproduced: confirm DEC-0001, agent supersede -> DEC-0002, reject DEC-0002 rc=0, DEC-0001.supersede_proposed_by still DEC-0002, agent supersede DEC-0001 rc=1, validate-artifact --type decisions rc=0.
critique: op_reject and op_supersede each know half of the invariant.
remediation: Null the old row's pointer in the same write, include it in touched, allow that transition in the validator when the named row is rejected; add a reject-then-supersede test.
